verdict.rationale: USCIS publishes a formal delegation rail. Form G-28 establishes an attorney or accredited representative's eligibility to act for a client (uscis-supp-4). Representatives file on the client's behalf through a dedicated representative online account and can submit subsequent G-28s online (uscis-docs-18, uscis-docs-19). The Torch Case Status API is explicitly offered to customers and their representatives (uscis-docs-1, uscis-supp-1). Missing for 10: online G-28 filing is limited to certain pending forms, there is no machine/API rail for representatives beyond case status and FOIA (uscis-supp-3), and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration.
